description: Complete DNS inspection in one call over DNS-over-HTTPS: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA and CAA records with TTLs — plus a derived email posture analysis (SPF present and policy, DMARC present and policy, MX count, overall assessment) that raw lookup tools don't do. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

types.description: Record types to query (default: all eight)
